title: Ez Boats
description: A lightweight Vanilla+ mod that lets you quickly enter boats using a simple Shift key bind.
body:
**Ez Boats**
Ez Boats is a lightweight Vanilla+ mod designed to improve your maritime experience in Minecraft. Stop struggling to click on moving boats! With this mod, you can enter any boat instantly with a simple key press.

- Features
Easy Mounting: Simply tap the Shift key (Crouch) while looking at a boat to enter it automatically.

Smart Detection: Works within a 5-block radius, so you don't have to be pixel-perfect.

Safety First: To prevent accidental mounting, you must be holding a specific "safety" item (like a Shield or a Totem of Undying) to trigger the auto-mount.

Vanilla Friendly: No new items or complex menus. It just works!

- Compatibility
Built for Fabric.

Works perfectly alongside its sibling mod: Ez Elytra Boost.

- Credits
Developed by ItsRaphaelakosYT. Part of the "Ez" Series - making Minecraft gameplay smoother, one click at a time.
